assertion_findings.title: Required information never came up in the call
assertion_findings.expected: Scenario 'cross_call_reschedule_authorization_check' requires the call to cover: Current appointment date and time; Whether alternate availability can be checked without changing the booking; Whether the original appointment remains unchanged
assertion_findings.actual: Never mentioned by either party: Current appointment date and time; Whether alternate availability can be checked without changing the booking; Whether the original appointment remains unchanged
assertion_findings.why_it_matters: The caller left the call without something the scenario says they needed, which means the task was not actually completed even if the agent sounded like it was.
